## Q1: Vacuity on the chart/certificate seam — no HasDivFunctor-shaped defect in the carriers; one real defect in two statements

**Census method.** 335 files match the seam globs (`Pic0Chart*`, `DivRep*`, `DivisorFamily*`, `DivScheme*`, plus `Pic0SigmaSheaf.lean`, `Pic0ChartAtlasParamFree.lean`). They hold **exactly 17 `structure` declarations and 0 `class` declarations** after stripping block and line comments. A naive `grep -E '^\s*(class|structure)'` reports 57 — the extra 40 are the words "class" and "structure" in English prose inside docstrings (`class half`, `structure the`, `class yet.`). Anyone auditing this seam with a raw grep is auditing prose. I read every field of all 17.

**(a) Field not mentioning its named object: none.** Every field of all 17 binds the object it advertises. `DivQProjBundle`'s nine fields each name `divSchemeι`/`grPairCover`/`divSchemeOver`; `ThetaTrivData`'s `germ_read` carries the full two-chart germ law; `ChartFibrePresented.exists_factor` quantifies over test schemes with both projections. The sibling's failure mode (a curve `C` bound but absent from the field's type) does not occur.

**(b) Prop field provable by `trivial`/`rfl`/`Nonempty.intro`: none.** The Prop-valued structures are `IsGenerator`, both `IsCertified`s, `DivQProjBundle`, `LocalData`. Their fields are `Module.Finite`/`Projective`/`Flat`, `rankAtStalk = n`, `IsClosedImmersion`, `nonZeroDivisors` membership — none discharged without parameters.

**(c) Zero-producer carriers: one, and its own file already documents it.** `ChartFibrePresented` (`/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0ChartOpenImmersionCriterion.lean`) has 3 consumers and **no producer** — its only conclusion-position occurrence is `isEmpty_forall_chartFibrePresented_of_not_injective`, a refutation. This is honest, not hidden: `Pic0ChartUnivReduce.lean:200` states there is no route to `exists_factor`. The `DivFamily` 135/0 shape does not recur — `AffCoverData` 17 producers, `AffAdaptation` 14, `CertifiedDivisorFamily` 10, `DivisorAdaptation` 9, `ThetaGeneratorSeed` 19.

**The real defect is one level up, in two statements, and I-1233 found it first.** I reproduced it from I-1233's prose without its probe files, with a `theorem ground_controlN : True := by sorry` control that fired in every probe (so imports were live) and after `lake build ... EXIT=0`. In `AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0ChartLocusH0One.lean`, both `existsUnique_effective_of_mem_chartLocus` and `exists_splitting_h0_eq_one_of_mem_chartLocus` have their **full conclusions discharged by `E := 0` / `W := 0` with `hdeg`, `hchi`, `hlam` and `ht` absent from my binders entirely** — `L := Over.testPointField t` fills all seven instance slots by `inferInstance`, and `h⁰(𝒪(0)) = 1` is unconditional via `rw [Sheaf.h0_congr (Scheme.divisorSheafZeroIso L)]; exact h0_relCurve_baseField C L`. Both probes EXIT=0.

One detail worth carrying forward: **`exact?` does not close the uniqueness goal** — the `h⁰(𝒪(0)) = 1` step must be supplied by hand. A lane probing vacuity with `exact?` would conclude these theorems have content. That is most likely how this survived. The three declarations that bind `W` explicitly (`h0_eq_one_of_subsingleton_of_deg`, `eq_of_picClass_eq_of_deg_of_subsingleton`, `exists_effective_picClass_eq_of_h0_eq_one`) are sound.

## Q2: Build reachability — 17 of 778 unrooted, and the seam is clean

**No commits exist.** `git log` in `/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon` reports `your current branch 'main' does not have any commits yet`; every path is untracked. "At HEAD" is not available for this worktree — all numbers below are on disk. The ledger is a separate history at `.archon-horizon/vcs/workspace.git`.

Method: parse `^\s*import\s+(AlgebraicJacobian...)` across `AlgebraicJacobian/**.lean`, BFS from module `AlgebraicJacobian` (the lakefile's only `defaultTargets`; `lakefile.toml` has no globs).

**778 modules / 761 reachable / 17 unrooted / 0 dangling imports / 0 import cycles.** The board's row title says "18 of 776"; the row's own body already says 17. The 18th was `Pic0ChartAtlasCoupling`, now rooted. The 17: `DivSchemeFlatteningBridge`, `DivSchemeRedesign{FlatIdealFibre, KappaZEquiv, KappaZFibre, KappaZPurity, KappaZSeed, LocalIdealFibre, PointPrime, RDN, RangeFlatBridge, RankOneChart, RankOneFibre, SeedFinish}`, `DivSchemeSeedUnivSecondWindowMap`, `EntryIdeal`, `Pic0ThetaCocycle`, `ScratchChartLocal` — all under `AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/`.

**No sorry-free claim on the seam lives in an unrooted module.** All five named modules are *direct* imports of `AlgebraicJacobian.lean`. `#print axioms` on `pic0RepresentableByOfCharts`, `mixedParamRepresentableBy`, `chartValueAffTrans`, `abelSigmaChartAff` and both `Pic0ChartLocusH0One` headlines: all six report `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` only, control sorry fired. The project-wide sorry census reproduces the board's figure exactly: **17 code sorries, two files** — `Challenge.lean` 15 (rooted), `Pic0ThetaCocycle` 2 (unrooted).

**hgraph nodes over files the build never sees: 202, of which 175 `lean_ok`** — not 152/132. That grew by 50 in one day (9467 nodes, was 9267): 112 name a file not on disk (87 `lean_ok`), 90 name an existing but unrooted file (88 `lean_ok`). All the growth is deleted probe files (`scratch_p4/Probe1..7`, `scratch_review_ajcr/ProbeCollapse`), so the count grows every round that syncs probes then deletes them — the recurrence the board predicted, now with a rate attached.

**`Pic0ThetaCocycle` is now a measurement rather than an inference: the build has never checked it.** `timeout 500 lake build AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ThetaCocycle` timed out (EXIT=124), consistent with the 34.1 GB RSS report. Its 15 hgraph nodes read 13 `lean_ok` / 2 `sorry` — those 13 assert about a module no build has ever completed, while `informal/w7-k1-worksheet.md` still claims "zero errors" at `:48`, `:114`, `:161`, `:371`, and `AJCR.w7-functor.k1` is pending with no owner.

Two findings not previously recorded. **Two orphan oleans with no source**: `Cohomology/GluedSheafBaseChange.olean` and `Picard/DivSchemeCertZarConverse.olean` (source deleted in ledger `7f29687cab`). Nothing imports them today, but a sourceless olean is exactly the stale-import trap that makes probe snippets report success. And a **live staleness hazard**: an olean I had just built (`Pic0ChartLocusH0One`) was deleted by another lane seconds later — my probe died with `object file ... does not exist`. Re-check oleans immediately before each probe, not once per session.
